title: Video Friday: Spot Plays to Show Its Whole-Body Manipulation
summary: Video Friday is your weekly selection of awesome robotics videos, collected by your friends at IEEE Spectrum robotics. We also post a weekly calendar of upcoming robotics events for the next few months. Please send us your events for inclusion. CoRL 2026 : 9–12 November 2026, AUSTIN Humanoids 2026 : 6–9 December 2026, SANTA CLARA, CA Enjoy today’s videos!

extra.full_text: Video Friday is your weekly selection of awesome robotics videos, collected by your friends at IEEE Spectrum robotics. We also post a weekly calendar of upcoming robotics events for the next few months. Please send us your events for inclusion. CoRL 2026 : 9–12 November 2026, AUSTIN Humanoids 2026 : 6–9 December 2026, SANTA CLARA, CA Enjoy today’s videos! Some top-notch whole-body manipulation here from RAI, although it’s a little hard to tell whether there’s direct torso involvement, which is something that humans do with heavy or awkward stuff all the time. “Anything that shows up as a blob in a depth image can be taken for the tire, whether a person walking past or a stray object on the floor. In a few runs the robot left the tire and went after something else.” That “something else” seems suspiciously vague, doesn’t it? [ Robotics and AI Institute ] We present a contact-centric learning framework for versatile humanoid mobility in complex and unstructured environments. Our approach bridges motion imitation and reinforcement learning by leveraging human motion data as a training prior while enabling autonomous adaptation to previously unseen terrains. [ ETH Zurich Robotic Systems Lab ] You’ve literally heard me say it a thousand times: The only things that could possibly make Reachy Mini better would be some wheels and a whole bunch of fancy hats. But of course the only way I could possibly recommend the wheels is if Reachy Mini can totally wreck Microduck in a race. [ Pollen Robotics ] Luxonis is launching OAK 4 FFC, a 70 x 53 mm vision computer that lets humanoid and drone builders put up to five cameras wherever the robot needs them. The board runs sync, stereo depth, and AI itself, and calibrates from the scene instead of a checkerboard. [ Luxonis ] Thanks, Carson! Coming soon: Mini Pupper 4! [ MangDang ] HX Friends explores different robotic hand designs powered by DYNAMIXEL, ranging from a single articulated finger and a gripper to three-, four-, and five-finger hands. The video includes motion demonstrations across the lineup and VR teleoperation of the multifinger hands. [ Robotis ] Thanks, Hyunwoo! Developed by bluZenit, monkeyBot 2.0 is an innovative robotic platform designed to navigate complex industrial piping systems. Inspired by nature, monkeyBot 2.0 uses a unique gripping and climbing mechanism to move along vertical and horizontal pipes, navigate bends, and access challenging locations within industrial facilities. [ bluZenit ] Thanks, Trevor! I understand that you need some kind of repeatable baseline or whatever for training robots to do stuff, but I would be so much more impressed with any cleaning robot at all if it would clean stuff that was actually dirty for once. [ Generalist ] Calling this a “robot” hand at this point might be a little bit premature, but this is the kind of technology we’re going to need for deployable robots that are compliant and safe. [ BruBotics Human Robotics Research Center ] Robotiq really is the OG of industrial manipulation, aren’t they? And they’ve got a new tactile sensing gripper, too. [ Robotiq ] Introducing ANYmal X, which is the least likely to explode quadruped currently available for purchase. [ ANYbotics ] For those of us who prefer to play tennis alone. [ LimX Dynamics ] At Yulong River Scenic Area in Guangxi, China, DEEPRobotics’ Lite3 quadruped robot and LYNX M20 wheeled-legged robot are working together across a range of real-world tourism scenarios. [ DEEPRobotics ] In April 2025, the MAVLab team from TU Delft competed in the A2RL Drone Racing Championship in Abu Dhabi. Their AI algorithm MonoRace won the AI Grand Challenge and then beat three human FPV world champions. The drone uses only a single onboard camera and an IMU for state estimation. An onboard neural network maps the estimated state directly to motor commands. [ MonoRace via Science Robotics ] This video from Starship is worth watching mostly for the b-roll of their early prototypes. [ Starship ] Meet SAWbot, a bio-inspired amphibious robot that swims using a continuous wavelike motion powered by a single motor. SAWbot is among the most energy-efficient swimming robots reported to date. It can swim, crawl on land, and transition between water and land while generating minimal disturbance to aquatic life. [ Paper via IEEE Robotics and Automation ] If you missed IROS this year, a bunch of the talks are now online, and here are a couple of good ones. [ IROS 2026 ]

summary: 미국 인공지능(AI) 로봇 전문 기업인 리얼보틱스(Realbotix)가 인간-로봇 인터랙션(상호작용)이 가능한 동반형 휴머노이드 로봇 ‘에코(Echo)’를 출시했다고 로보틱스247이 지난 26일(현지시간) 보도했다.라스베이거스에 본사를 둔 리얼보틱스는 에코 플랫폼이 동반자 관계 구축, 교육, 웰니스를 목적으로 설계됐으며, 인간과 로봇 간의 의미있는 상호작용을 지원토록 제작됐다고 밝혔다. 또한 에코의 단순화된 모듈식 아키텍처 덕분에 고객이 돌봄과 지원이 필요한 환경에서 실용적 가치를 제공하는 로봇을 쉽게 설정할 수 있다고 설명했다.◇

title: "미국 FCC 로봇 규제, 2030년 美 휴머노이드 매출 전망 58% 낮춘다"
summary: 미국 연방통신위원회(FCC)의 외국산 첨단 로봇 규제가 미국 휴머노이드 로봇 시장에 큰 타격을 줄 것이라는 분석이 나왔다. 규제 이전 전망과 비교해 2030년 미국 휴머노이드 로봇 매출이 58% 낮아지고, 2026년부터 2030년까지 미국 로봇산업의 누적 매출 손실이 60억 달러를 넘어설 것으로 예상됐다.시장조사업체 IDC는 최근 발표한 분석에서 FCC의 로봇 규제가 미국 휴머노이드 로봇 산업의 성장 경로를 크게 바꿀 것으로 내다봤다. 이에 따라 미국 휴머노이드 로봇 시장의 연평균 성장률 전망치는 기존 13%에서 약 9%로 낮아질

summary: 미국 AI 기반 로봇 실험실 자동화 기업 오픈트론스 랩웍스(Opentrons Labworks)가 4천만 달러(약 535억원)의 신규 투자를 유치하고 실험실 자동화 사업 확대에 나섰다. 오픈트론스는 헬스케어 전문 투자사 에이베고(Avego)가 주도하고 브로드오크 캐피털 파트너스(BroadOak Capital Partners)가 참여한 시리즈E 투자 라운드에서 4천만 달러를 조달했다고 밝혔다. 이번 투자금은 로봇 기술과 소프트웨어, 데이터 인프라를 확장하는 데 활용할 계획이다.지난 2014년 설립된 오픈트론스 랩웍스는 실험실에서 반복적
